title: Design System: Hoong Wei Jun Portfolio

extensions.extraction: Current cascade only: clay.css loads last and content HTML forces light. Legacy base dark/green/Manrope declarations and archived motion assets are not canonical.

constraints.landing: No video, typewriter, animations, transitions or spatial hover movement.
constraints.content: Keep real portrait, factual projects, original evidence, CV and existing routes.
constraints.interactions: Native menu, evidence viewer, project selectors and email copying remain available.

reducedMotion.behavior: Disable animation/transition globally and suppress the explicitly listed work-card/button/hero-action transforms. Homepage is static regardless of preference.

extensions.componentScope: Preview snippets show static homepage material. Limited case-page transform/transition behavior is recorded in DESIGN.md and motion extensions.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Violet-gradient action with readable white text; static homepage presentation.
components.css: .ds-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:52px; padding:14px 22px; border:0; border-radius:20px; background:var(--button-gradient); color:#ffffff; font-family:"DM Sans",sans-serif; font-size:.85rem; font-weight:700; text-decoration:none; box-shadow:var(--clay-button); } .ds-primary:hover { background:var(--button-gradient); color:#ffffff; } .ds-primary:active { box-shadow:inset 6px 6px 12px rgb(35 10 70 / .45), inset -6px -6px 12px rgb(238 220 255 / .15); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--green); outline-offset:5px; }

components.name: Secondary Action
components.description: Translucent light action with clay button shadow.
components.css: .ds-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:52px; padding:14px 22px; border:0; border-radius:20px; background:var(--surface); color:var(--ink); font-family:"DM Sans",sans-serif; font-size:.85rem; font-weight:700; text-decoration:none; box-shadow:var(--clay-button); } .ds-secondary:hover { background:var(--surface); color:var(--ink); } .ds-secondary:active { box-shadow:var(--clay-pressed); } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--green); outline-offset:5px; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Light floating clay shell; links use ink and violet current/hover emphasis.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:26px; min-height:76px; padding:0 24px; background:var(--surface); border-radius:32px; box-shadow:var(--clay-card); backdrop-filter:blur(16px); } .ds-nav a { color:var(--ink); font-family:"DM Sans",sans-serif; font-size:.85rem; font-weight:700; padding-block:12px; text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav a:hover,.ds-nav a[aria-current] { color:var(--green); text-decoration:underline; text-underline-offset:.22em; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--green); outline-offset:5px; }

components.name: Tags
components.description: Unboxed supporting labels without a selectable state.
components.css: .ds-tags { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px 20px; color:var(--muted); font-family:"DM Sans",sans-serif; font-weight:500; font-size:.75rem; }

components.name: Process Step
components.description: Selectable project step with inset selected surface; behavior remains in site.js.
components.css: .ds-process { background:var(--surface); color:var(--ink); border:0; border-radius:24px; box-shadow:var(--clay-button); padding:20px; text-align:left; font-family:"DM Sans",sans-serif; font-weight:500; cursor:pointer; } .ds-process[aria-pressed=true] { background:var(--card); box-shadow:var(--clay-pressed); } .ds-process:hover { background:var(--surface); } .ds-process b { color:var(--green); font-size:.8rem; } .ds-process span { display:block; margin-top:24px; font-size:.95rem; font-weight:700; } .ds-process:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--green); outline-offset:5px; }

components.name: Contact Path
components.description: Rounded contact destination with card shadow and a supporting label.
components.css: .ds-contact { display:block; padding:22px 28px; border:0; border-radius:20px; background:var(--surface); color:var(--ink); box-shadow:var(--clay-card); font-family:"DM Sans",sans-serif; font-weight:500; text-decoration:none; } .ds-contact:hover { background:var(--surface); } .ds-contact small { font-size:.75rem; color:var(--green); } .ds-contact h3 { font-family:Nunito,sans-serif; font-size:1.2rem; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:-.025em; line-height:1.25; margin:4px 0 0; } .ds-contact:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--green); outline-offset:5px; }

narrative.overview: The user-pinned clay system makes the portfolio light, vibrant and lively through soft volumes, violet/pink/blue accents, pastel groups and the real person. The homepage is static: the statement “Curious mind. Creative energy. Ideas in action.” appears beside the existing portrait. Professional title, factual projects, original evidence, CV and routes remain the content foundation.
keyCharacteristics: Light lavender ground with charcoal text and violet, pink, blue, mint and amber accents.
Nunito headings, DM Sans body and large rounded clay surfaces.
Static homepage personality with useful native menu, evidence and project controls.
dos: Do keep all pages light and use the canonical clay stylesheet after the base layout stylesheet.
Do express the homepage's creative personality with the real portrait, typography, color and static clay material.
Do retain visible violet focus, native controls, working evidence links and factual project content.
Do use the documented control, card and frame radii with the actual multi-layer shadows.
donts: Don't reintroduce video, typewriter, animations, transitions or spatial hover movement on the landing page.
Don't restore a dark theme or theme-switch control.
Don't promote legacy green, Manrope or pill tokens back into the active clay system.
Don't invent professional claims, credentials, testimonials or project evidence.
